device_channels: A and B are separate studies; only physically verified available channels participate
reference: Measured torso plane before and after every trial, with instrument and explicit positive uncertainty bound
reference_stability: absolute start/end difference <= twice the declared uncertainty bound
freshness: Operator-verified new-range sequence or device-age semantics; repeated packet receipts and equal range values do not establish freshness
acquisition_clock: nullable; device-age subtraction is explicitly a host-clock proxy
privacy: Range, presence, verified age/sequence, clock and device metadata only; never persist HR, BR, faces, raw serial payloads or unknown fields

methods.D1: H1 offset-corrected fresh measurement, no temporal filter
methods.D3: Same selected filter with 0.999 innovation gate and no automatic reset

parameter_selection: H2 macro-average fresh-event RMSE, tie broken by smaller process density
primary_support: Common fresh range events whose receipt and verified observation proxy are both in [10,40) seconds
secondary_support: Host receipt prediction RMSE and availability, separately labelled
no_target_analysis: Count fresh positive range observations; do not compute invented target-position error
gates: No serial opening before explicit physical and consent declarations
Complete checksummed H1/H2 records for every scheduled condition
Freeze exact source, calibration, capability and input hashes before any H3 capture
No re-recording completed conditions; preserve interrupted attempts under new identifiers
No equipment purchases, flashing, joint radar fusion or 3D claims
